name: unimol
protocol: 5 x 5 GroupKFold over chemical clusters, one fixed holdout, Tukey HSD

reports.title: Uni-Mol and Uni-Mol2, out of the box
reports.question: Do Uni-Mol and Uni-Mol2, fine-tuned with their own package at its defaults, hold up against the ADMET field?
reports.takeaway: Uni-Mol2 84M is a real step up from Uni-Mol and beats fine-tuned CheMeleon, but it trails fine-tuned Atom-JEPA everywhere and Monroe + TabPFN 3 on Biogen. Frozen, neither Uni-Mol vector wins a single call against Monroe's.
reports.summary: Uni-Mol and Uni-Mol2 pre-train 3D transformers on hundreds of millions of conformers, and ship a fine-tuning package, unimol_tools. Both are fine-tuned here with that package's own multitask recipe at its defaults, 25 fold models each, and both encoders are also frozen and read by TabPFN 3 with Monroe's exact call, against LightGBM, fine-tuned CheMeleon, Monroe + TabPFN 3 and fine-tuned Atom-JEPA.
reports.finding: Fine-tuned Uni-Mol2 beats Uni-Mol 30–12–3 over 45 endpoint × metric calls, fine-tuned CheMeleon 31–8–6 and LightGBM 42–3–0, and reaches the top Tukey tier on 14 of 27 ExpansionRx combinations, never alone. It splits ExpansionRx with Monroe + TabPFN 3 (14–5–8) but loses all 18 Biogen calls, and trails fine-tuned Atom-JEPA 3–6–36. Frozen under TabPFN 3 both Uni-Mol vectors lose all 45 calls to Monroe's; fine-tuning wins 40 and 41 of 45 against them.
reports.caveat: The package fits its target scaler on all five training fifths before splitting, so each held-out fifth slightly informs the scaling used for early stopping; the test set is never involved. Uni-Mol2 310M was dropped because it does not fit at batch 16 in 16 GB.
